verses.sloka: तम् दृष्ट्वा जृंभमाणम् ते क्रमितुम् शत योजनम् ।वेगेन आपूर्यमाणम् च सहसा वानरोत्तमम् ॥४-६७-१॥
verses.transliteration: tam dṛṣṭvā jṛṁbhamāṇam te kramitum śata yojanam ।vegena āpūryamāṇam ca sahasā vānarottamam ॥4-67-1॥

translations.english: 'In order to cross a hundred yojanas, Hanuman, the best of monkeys expanded his might and strength. Seeing him, a warrior of great strength, all the monkeys, filled with enthusiasm at once gave up grief and collected together.They rejoiced and propitiated him screaming aloud.
translations.hindi: धी: ॥ श्रीमद्रामायणपारायणो पक्रमः नोठ---सनातन धर्म के श्रन्तर्गत जिन बैदिक सम्प्रदायों में श्रीमद्रामायण का पारायण होता है, उन्हीं सम्प्रदायों के श्रनुसार उपक्रम आर समापन क्रम प्रत्येक खण्ड के प्रादि श्रौर भ्रन्त में करमशः दे विए गए हैं। श्रीवेष्णवसस्प्रदायः कूजन्तं राम रामेति मधुरं मधुराक्षरम्‌ । ग्रारह्म कविताशाखां बन्दे वाल्मीकिकोकिलम्‌

verses.sloka: सहसा शोकम् उत्सृज्य प्रहर्षेण समन्विताः ।विनेदुः तुष्टुवुः च अपि हनूमन्तम् महाबलम् ॥४-६७-२॥
verses.transliteration: sahasā śokam utsṛjya praharṣeṇa samanvitāḥ ।vineduḥ tuṣṭuvuḥ ca api hanūmantam mahābalam ॥4-67-2॥

translations.english: 'In order to cross a hundred yojanas, Hanuman, the best of monkeys expanded his might and strength. Seeing him, a warrior of great strength, all the monkeys, filled with enthusiasm at once gave up grief and collected together.They rejoiced and propitiated him screaming aloud.
translations.hindi: दुष्करं निष्प्रतिदवन्दं चिकीषन्क्मं वानरः । समुदग्रशिरोग्रीवो गवां पतिरिवाऽऽबभौ ॥ २ १ इस प्रकार के दुष्कर कर्म करने की इच्छा कर, सिर ग्रौर गर्दन उठा कर, वृषभ की तरह, प्रतिद्वन्द्रीरहित अ्रथवा विघ्नवाघा-रहित, हनुमान जी शोभायमान हुए

verses.sloka: प्रहृष्टा विस्मिताः च अपि ते वीक्षन्ते समंततः ।त्रिविक्रम कृत उत्साहम् नारायणम् इव प्रजाः ॥४-६७-३॥
verses.transliteration: prahṛṣṭā vismitāḥ ca api te vīkṣante samaṁtataḥ ।trivikrama kṛta utsāham nārāyaṇam iva prajāḥ ॥4-67-3॥

translations.english: The monkeys collected together happily, gazing at Hanuman.They were wonderstruck to see Hanuman in that huge form, just as all beings were when they saw Lord Narayana in his incarnation of Vamana.

verses.sloka: संस्तूयमानो हनुमान् व्यवर्धत महाबलः ।समाविद्ध्य च लांगूलम् हर्षात् बलम् उपेयिवान् ॥४-६७-४॥
verses.transliteration: saṁstūyamāno hanumān vyavardhata mahābalaḥ ।samāviddhya ca lāṁgūlam harṣāt balam upeyivān ॥4-67-4॥

translations.english: The monkeys praised the mighty Hanuman as he grew in size whirling his tail around joyfully.
translations.hindi: सलिनकल्पेषू--समुद्रजनवत्‌ । (रा१) २ सुन्दरकाण्डे उस समय बुद्धिमान्‌ हनुमानजी, पक्षियों को त्रस्त करते, अपनी छाती की टक्कर से अनेक वृक्षों को उखाड़ते और बहुत से मृगो को मारते हुए ऐसे जान पड़ते थे, मानों वड़ा भयंकर सिंह हो

verses.sloka: तस्य संस्तूयमानस्य सर्वैः वनर पुंगवैः ।तेजसा आपूर्यमाणस्य रूपम् आसीत् अनुत्तमम् ॥४-६७-५॥
verses.transliteration: tasya saṁstūyamānasya sarvaiḥ vanara puṁgavaiḥ ।tejasā āpūryamāṇasya rūpam āsīt anuttamam ॥4-67-5॥

translations.english: As Hanuman was being praised by the monkey leaders, his body filled with lustre. It looked excellent.
translations.hindi: नीली, लाल, मजीठी ग्रौर कमल के रंग की तथा सफेद एवं काले रंग की रंग बिरंगी स्वभावसिद्ध धातुश्रों से भूषित, विविध भाँति के श्राभूषणों और वस्त्रों को पहिने हुए और अपने अपने परिवीरों सहित देवताओं की तरह कामरूपी यक्ष, गन्धवं, किन्नर और सर्पो से सेवित ,तथा उत्तम जाति के हाथियों से व्याप्त, उस महेन्द्र पवंत की तलैटी में, वानरश्रेष्ठ हनुमानजी, सरोवरस्थित हाथी की तरह शोभायमान हुए

verses.sloka: यथा विजृंभते सिंहो विवृते गिरि गह्वरे ।मारुतस्य औरसः पुत्रः तथा संप्रति जृंभते ॥४-६७-६॥
verses.transliteration: yathā vijṛṁbhate siṁho vivṛte giri gahvare ।mārutasya aurasaḥ putraḥ tathā saṁprati jṛṁbhate ॥4-67-6॥

translations.english: Just as a lion grown in a mountain cave stretches its body, the Windgod's son stretched (his limbs) at that time.

verses.sloka: अशोभत मुखम् तस्य जृंभमाणस्य धीमतः ।अंबरीष उपमम् दीप्तम् विधूम इव पावकः ॥४-६७-७॥
verses.transliteration: aśobhata mukham tasya jṛṁbhamāṇasya dhīmataḥ ।aṁbarīṣa upamam dīptam vidhūma iva pāvakaḥ ॥4-67-7॥

translations.english: On expansion, wise Hanuman's face was bright, glowing like a burning oven and shining like smokeless fire.

verses.sloka: हरीणाम् उत्थितो मध्यात् संप्रहृष्ट तनू रुहः ।अभिवाद्य हरीन् वृद्धान् हनुमान् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥४-६७-८॥
verses.transliteration: harīṇām utthito madhyāt saṁprahṛṣṭa tanū ruhaḥ ।abhivādya harīn vṛddhān hanumān idam abravīt ॥4-67-8॥

translations.english: Hanuman risen from the midst of the monkeys with his hair bristling on the body (due to expansion of body), saluted reverentially to the elderly monkey Jambavan and said :

verses.sloka: अरुजन् पर्वत अग्राणि हुताशन सखो अनिलः ।बलवान् अप्रमेयः च वायुः आकाश गोचरः ॥४-६७-९॥
verses.transliteration: arujan parvata agrāṇi hutāśana sakho anilaḥ ।balavān aprameyaḥ ca vāyuḥ ākāśa gocaraḥ ॥4-67-9॥

translations.english: 'The Windgod is a friend of fire who is a powerful consumer of oblations. His strength is immeasurable. He wanders in the sky and shatters the mountain tops.

verses.sloka: तस्य अहम् शीघ्र वेगस्य शीघ्र गस्य महात्मनः ।मारुतस्य औरसः पुत्रः प्लवने च अस्मि तत् समः ॥४-६७-१०॥
verses.transliteration: tasya aham śīghra vegasya śīghra gasya mahātmanaḥ ।mārutasya aurasaḥ putraḥ plavane ca asmi tat samaḥ ॥4-67-10॥

translations.english: 'I am the lawfulson of the swiftmoving Windgod, Maruta, comparable to him in leaping.
translations.hindi: बदवद्ये परे पुंसि जाते दशरथात्मजे । बदः प्राचेतसादासीत्साक्षाद्रामायणात्मना

verses.sloka: उत्सहेयम् हि विस्तीर्णम् आलिखंतम् इव अंबरम् ।मेरुम् गिरिम् असंगेन परिगंतुम् सहस्रशः ॥४-६७-११॥
verses.transliteration: utsaheyam hi vistīrṇam ālikhaṁtam iva aṁbaram ।merum girim asaṁgena parigaṁtum sahasraśaḥ ॥4-67-11॥

translations.english: 'I can with all enthusiasm go round the vast mount Meru a thousand times without resting on it which is as though scratching the sky.

verses.sloka: बाहु वेग प्रणुन्नेन सागरेण अहम् उत्सहे ।समाप्लावयितुम् लोकम् स पर्वत नदी ह्रदम् ॥४-६७-१२॥
verses.transliteration: bāhu vega praṇunnena sāgareṇa aham utsahe ।samāplāvayitum lokam sa parvata nadī hradam ॥4-67-12॥

translations.english: 'I can submerge this world including its mountains rivers and lakes. I can push back the sea waters quickly with my arms.

verses.sloka: मम ऊरु जन्घा वेगेन भविष्यति समुत्थितः ।समुत्थित महा ग्राहः समुद्रो वरुण आलयः ॥४-६७-१३॥
verses.transliteration: mama ūru janghā vegena bhaviṣyati samutthitaḥ ।samutthita mahā grāhaḥ samudro varuṇa ālayaḥ ॥4-67-13॥

translations.english: 'Thrust by my thighs,the ocean will rise up, carrying with it the shanks and mighty crocodiles stunned by the force.

verses.sloka: पन्नग अशनम् आकाशे पतन्तम् पक्षि सेवितम् ।वैनतेयम् अहम् शक्तः परिगंतुम् सहस्रशः ॥४-६७-१४॥
verses.transliteration: pannaga aśanam ākāśe patantam pakṣi sevitam ।vainateyam aham śaktaḥ parigaṁtum sahasraśaḥ ॥4-67-14॥

translations.english: 'I am capable of circumambulating a thousand times the great Garuda who consumes snakes and flies in the sky, the abode of birds.

verses.sloka: उदयात् प्रस्थितम् वा अपि ज्वलंतम् रश्मि मालिनम् ।अन् अस्तमितम् आदित्यम् अभिगंतुम् समुत्सहे ॥४-६७-१५॥
verses.transliteration: udayāt prasthitam vā api jvalaṁtam raśmi mālinam ।an astamitam ādityam abhigaṁtum samutsahe ॥4-67-15॥

translations.english: 'O bull among monkeys when the Sun rises from behind the eastern mountain it is possible for me to start with him and go to the western horizon and return before the blazing Sun with its beams of light sets. It is also possible for me to descend to the earth with the same speed and return to the Sun without touching the earth.

verses.sloka: ततो भूमिम् असंस्पृष्ट्वा पुनः आगन्तुम् उत्सहे ।प्रवेगेन एव महता भीमेन प्लवगर्षभाः ॥४-६७-१६॥
verses.transliteration: tato bhūmim asaṁspṛṣṭvā punaḥ āgantum utsahe ।pravegena eva mahatā bhīmena plavagarṣabhāḥ ॥4-67-16॥

translations.english: 'O bull among monkeys when the Sun rises from behind the eastern mountain it is possible for me to start with him and go to the western horizon and return before the blazing Sun with its beams of light sets. It is also possible for me to descend to the earth with the same speed and return to the Sun without touching the earth.
translations.hindi: वेदवेद्ये परे पुंसि जाते दशरथात्मजे । येदः प्राचेतसादासोत्साक्षाद्रामायणात्मना

verses.sloka: उत्सहेयम् अतिक्रांतुम् सर्वान् आकाश गोचरान् ।सागरम् शोषयिष्यामि दारयिष्यामि मेदिनीम् ॥४-६७-१७॥
verses.transliteration: utsaheyam atikrāṁtum sarvān ākāśa gocarān ।sāgaram śoṣayiṣyāmi dārayiṣyāmi medinīm ॥4-67-17॥

translations.english: 'If I rise up, I can overtake all those creatures flying in the sky and from there I can stir up the ocean and tear up the earth easily.
translations.hindi: घेदवेच्चे परे पुंसि जाते दशरथात्मजे । वेद: प्राचेतसादासीत्साक्षाद्रामायणात्मना

verses.sloka: पर्वतान् चूर्णष्यामि प्लवमानः प्लवंगमाः ।हरिष्यामि ऊरु वेगेन प्लवमानो महाअर्णवम् ॥४-६७-१८॥
verses.transliteration: parvatān cūrṇaṣyāmi plavamānaḥ plavaṁgamāḥ ।hariṣyāmi ūru vegena plavamāno mahāarṇavam ॥4-67-18॥

translations.english: 'O monkeys when I leap, I can crush the mountains into powder and pull the vast ocean with me with the force of my thighs.

verses.sloka: लतानाम् विविधाम् पुष्पम् पादपानाम् च सर्वशः ।अनुयास्यति माम् अद्य प्लवमानम् विहायसा ॥४-६७-१९॥
verses.transliteration: latānām vividhām puṣpam pādapānām ca sarvaśaḥ ।anuyāsyati mām adya plavamānam vihāyasā ॥4-67-19॥

translations.english: And then as I leap through the sky flowers of many kinds of creepers and trees will follow me.

verses.sloka: भविष्यति हि मे पन्थाः स्वातेः पन्था इव अंबरे ।चरन्तम् घोरम् आकाशम् उत्पतिष्यन्तम् एव च ॥४-६७-२०॥
verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyati hi me panthāḥ svāteḥ panthā iva aṁbare ।carantam ghoram ākāśam utpatiṣyantam eva ca ॥4-67-20॥

translations.english: 'O monkey when I fly upward in the dreadful sky or descend down, all creatures will see me, for my path will be the path of the constellation of Swati (a group of stars).

verses.sloka: द्रक्ष्यन्ति निपतन्तम् च सर्व भूतानि वानराः ।महा मेरु प्रतीकाशम् माम् द्रक्ष्यध्वम् प्लवंगमाः ॥४-६७-२१॥
verses.transliteration: drakṣyanti nipatantam ca sarva bhūtāni vānarāḥ ।mahā meru pratīkāśam mām drakṣyadhvam plavaṁgamāḥ ॥4-67-21॥

translations.english: 'O monkeys when I fly in the sky like the great mount Meru, you will see me as if I am swallowing the sky because I will be enveloping it with my strides.

verses.sloka: दिवम् आवृत्य गच्छन्तम् ग्रसमानम् इव अंबरम् ।विधमिष्यामि जीमूतान् कंपयिष्यामि पर्वतान् ।सागरम् शोषयिष्यामि प्लवमानः समाहितः ॥४-६७-२२॥
verses.transliteration: divam āvṛtya gacchantam grasamānam iva aṁbaram ।vidhamiṣyāmi jīmūtān kaṁpayiṣyāmi parvatān ।sāgaram śoṣayiṣyāmi plavamānaḥ samāhitaḥ ॥4-67-22॥

translations.english: Leaping in concentration, I shall scatter the clouds, shake the mountains, and dry up the ocean.

verses.sloka: वैनतेयस्य वा शक्तिः मम वा मारुतस्य वा ।ऋते सुपर्ण राजानम् मारुतम् वा महाबलम् ।न तत् भूतम् प्रपश्यामि यत् माम् प्लुतम् अनुव्रजेत् ॥४-६७-२३॥
verses.transliteration: vainateyasya vā śaktiḥ mama vā mārutasya vā ।ṛte suparṇa rājānam mārutam vā mahābalam ।na tat bhūtam prapaśyāmi yat mām plutam anuvrajet ॥4-67-23॥

translations.english: 'Only Garuda and Maruta have the capacity to fly like me. No one other than the king of vultures and the Windgod have the speed to fly like me.

verses.sloka: निमेष अन्तर मात्रेण निरालंबनम् अंबरम् ।सहसा निपतिष्यामि घनात् विद्युत् इव उत्थिता ॥४-६७-२४॥
verses.transliteration: nimeṣa antara mātreṇa nirālaṁbanam aṁbaram ।sahasā nipatiṣyāmi ghanāt vidyut iva utthitā ॥4-67-24॥

translations.english: 'Only Garuda and Maruta have the capacity to fly like me. No one other than the king of vultures and the Windgod have the speed to fly like me.

verses.sloka: भविष्यति हि मे रूपम् प्लवमानस्य सागरम् ।विष्णोः प्रक्रममाणस्य तदा त्रीन् विक्रमान् इव ॥४-६७-२५॥
verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyati hi me rūpam plavamānasya sāgaram ।viṣṇoḥ prakramamāṇasya tadā trīn vikramān iva ॥4-67-25॥

translations.english: 'Just as the lightning generated by the clouds lands at once flying in the sky without any support I can also land in less than a moment.

verses.sloka: बुद्ध्या च अहम् प्रपश्यामि मनः चेष्टा च मे तथा ।अहम् द्रक्ष्यामि वैदेहीम् प्रमोदध्वम् प्लवंगमाः ॥४-६७-२६॥
verses.transliteration: buddhyā ca aham prapaśyāmi manaḥ ceṣṭā ca me tathā ।aham drakṣyāmi vaidehīm pramodadhvam plavaṁgamāḥ ॥4-67-26॥

translations.english: As I leap over the ocean, my form will be like that of Vishnu of old measuring out his three strides.

verses.sloka: मारुतस्य समो वेगे गरुडस्य समो जवे ।अयुतम् योजनानाम् तु गमिष्यामि इति मे मतिः ॥४-६७-२७॥
verses.transliteration: mārutasya samo vege garuḍasya samo jave ।ayutam yojanānām tu gamiṣyāmi iti me matiḥ ॥4-67-27॥

translations.english: 'O monkeys I have a feeling in my mind that I will see Vaidehi. Be happy.

verses.sloka: वासवस्य स वज्रस्य ब्रह्मणो वा स्वयंभुवः ।विक्रम्य सहसा हस्तात् अमृतम् तत् इह आनये ॥४-६७-२८॥
verses.transliteration: vāsavasya sa vajrasya brahmaṇo vā svayaṁbhuvaḥ ।vikramya sahasā hastāt amṛtam tat iha ānaye ॥4-67-28॥

translations.english: 'I am equal to Maruta and Garuda in speed. I feel I can cover ten thousand yojanas (at a stretch).

verses.sloka: लंकाम् वा अपि समुत्क्षिप्य गच्छेयम् इति मे मतिः ।तम् एवम् वानर श्रेष्ठम् गर्जन्तम् अमित प्रभम् ॥४-६७-२९॥
verses.transliteration: laṁkām vā api samutkṣipya gaccheyam iti me matiḥ ।tam evam vānara śreṣṭham garjantam amita prabham ॥4-67-29॥

translations.english: 'I think I can encounter Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt and obtain nectar from his hands. I can even confront Brahma, the selfborn creator courageously. I can even uproot Lanka and carry it.'

verses.sloka: प्रहृष्टा हरयः तत्र समुदैक्षन्त विस्मिताः ।तत् च अस्य वचनम् श्रुत्वा ज्ञातीनाम् शोक नाशनम् ॥४-६७-३०॥
verses.transliteration: prahṛṣṭā harayaḥ tatra samudaikṣanta vismitāḥ ।tat ca asya vacanam śrutvā jñātīnām śoka nāśanam ॥4-67-30॥

translations.english: The monkeys looked at him and were amazed, happy to see him roaring and shining in brilliance.

verses.sloka: उवाच परिसंहृष्टो जांबवान् प्लवगेश्वरः ।वीर केसरिणः पुत्र वेगवन् मारुत आत्मज ॥४-६७-३१॥
verses.transliteration: uvāca parisaṁhṛṣṭo jāṁbavān plavageśvaraḥ ।vīra kesariṇaḥ putra vegavan māruta ātmaja ॥4-67-31॥

translations.english: Jambavan, the finest of the monkeys, felt very glad on hearing his words which put an end to the sorrow of the kith and kin and said:

verses.sloka: ज्ञातीनाम् विपुलः शोकः त्वया तात प्रणाशितः ।तव कल्याण रुचयः कपि मुख्याः समागताः ॥४-६७-३२॥
verses.transliteration: jñātīnām vipulaḥ śokaḥ tvayā tāta praṇāśitaḥ ।tava kalyāṇa rucayaḥ kapi mukhyāḥ samāgatāḥ ॥4-67-32॥

translations.english: 'O son of Kesari O son of Maruta O hero you have removed the great grief of your race, dear

verses.sloka: मंगलम् कार्य सिद्धि अर्थम् करिष्यन्ति समाहिताः ।ऋषीणाम् च प्रसादेन कपि वृद्ध मतेन च ॥४-६७-३३॥
verses.transliteration: maṁgalam kārya siddhi artham kariṣyanti samāhitāḥ ।ṛṣīṇām ca prasādena kapi vṛddha matena ca ॥4-67-33॥

translations.english: Your well-wishers, the monkey chiefs, have gathered and will with one mind offer auspicious prayers for the success of your mission.

verses.sloka: गुरूणाम् च प्रसादेन प्लवस्व त्वम् महाअर्णवम् ।स्थास्यामः च एक पादेन यावत् आगमनम् तव ॥४-६७-३४॥
verses.transliteration: gurūṇām ca prasādena plavasva tvam mahāarṇavam ।sthāsyāmaḥ ca eka pādena yāvat āgamanam tava ॥4-67-34॥

translations.english: 'By the blessings of the sages and by the grace of the elderly monkeys may you cross over the vast ocean.

verses.sloka: त्वत् गतानि च सर्वेषाम् जीवितानि वन ओकसाम् ।ततः च हरि शार्दूलः तान् उवाच वन ओकसः ॥४-६७-३५॥
verses.transliteration: tvat gatāni ca sarveṣām jīvitāni vana okasām ।tataḥ ca hari śārdūlaḥ tān uvāca vana okasaḥ ॥4-67-35॥

translations.english: We will stand poised on one foot awaiting your return, for the lives of all us forest-dwellers depend upon you.

verses.sloka: को अपि लोके न मे वेगम् प्लवने धारयिष्यति ।एतानि हि नगस्य अस्य शिला संकट शालिनः ॥४-६७-३६॥
verses.transliteration: ko api loke na me vegam plavane dhārayiṣyati ।etāni hi nagasya asya śilā saṁkaṭa śālinaḥ ॥4-67-36॥

translations.english: Then the tiger among monkeys, Hanuman said to those forestdwellers (monkeys), 'The earth cannot bear the thrust of my leaping.

verses.sloka: शिखराणि महेन्द्रस्य स्थिराणि च महान्ति च ।येषु वेगम् गमिष्यामि महेन्द्र शिखरेषु अहम् ॥४-६७-३७॥
verses.transliteration: śikharāṇi mahendrasya sthirāṇi ca mahānti ca ।yeṣu vegam gamiṣyāmi mahendra śikhareṣu aham ॥4-67-37॥

translations.english: 'The rocks on the peaks of the ranges of mount Mahendra cannot with stand it, although they are huge and firm.

verses.sloka: नाना द्रुम विकीर्णेषु धातु निष्पन्द शोभिषु ।एतानि मम वेगम् हि शिखराणि महान्ति च ॥४-६७-३८॥
verses.transliteration: nānā druma vikīrṇeṣu dhātu niṣpanda śobhiṣu ।etāni mama vegam hi śikharāṇi mahānti ca ॥4-67-38॥

translations.english: 'I will pick up speed on the peaks of mount Mahendra filled with different kinds of trees and minerals.

verses.sloka: प्लवतो धारयिष्यन्ति योजनानाम् इतः शतम् ।ततः तु मारुत प्रख्यः स हरिः मारुत आत्मजः ।आरुरोह नग श्रेष्ठम् मह्न्द्रम् अरिंअर्दमः ॥४-६७-३९॥
verses.transliteration: plavato dhārayiṣyanti yojanānām itaḥ śatam ।tataḥ tu māruta prakhyaḥ sa hariḥ māruta ātmajaḥ ।āruroha naga śreṣṭham mahndram ariṁardamaḥ ॥4-67-39॥

translations.english: 'O great monkeys these mountain peaks can withstand the crushing force of my feet as I leap over a hundred yojanas.

verses.sloka: वृतम् नाना विधैः पुष्पैः मृग सेवित शाद्वलम् ।लता कुसुम संबाधम् नित्य पुष्प फल द्रुमम् ॥४-६७-४०॥
verses.transliteration: vṛtam nānā vidhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ mṛga sevita śādvalam ।latā kusuma saṁbādham nitya puṣpa phala drumam ॥4-67-40॥

translations.english: The son of Maruta, who was as eminent as the Windgod, the crusher of enemies ascended the great mountain Mahendra, full of grassland inhabited by deer, thickly grown with various trees and creepers full of fragrant flowers and fruits, where roam lions and tigers and proud elephants, a place that echoes with sounds of intoxicated birds and waterfalls.

verses.sloka: सिंह शार्दूल चरितम् मत्त मातंग सेवितम् ।मत्त द्विज गण उद् धुष्टम् सलिल उत्पीड संकुलम् ॥४-६७-४१॥
verses.transliteration: siṁha śārdūla caritam matta mātaṁga sevitam ।matta dvija gaṇa ud dhuṣṭam salila utpīḍa saṁkulam ॥4-67-41॥

translations.english: The son of Maruta, who was as eminent as the Windgod, the crusher of enemies ascended the great mountain Mahendra, full of grassland inhabited by deer, thickly grown with various trees and creepers full of fragrant flowers and fruits, where roam lions and tigers and proud elephants, a place that echoes with sounds of intoxicated birds and waterfalls.

verses.sloka: महद्भिः उच्छ्रितम् शृन्गैः महेन्द्रम् स महाबलः ।विचचार हरिश्रेष्ठो महेन्द्र साम विक्रमः ॥४-६७-४२॥
verses.transliteration: mahadbhiḥ ucchritam śṛngaiḥ mahendram sa mahābalaḥ ।vicacāra hariśreṣṭho mahendra sāma vikramaḥ ॥4-67-42॥

translations.english: The son of Maruta, who was as eminent as the Windgod, the crusher of enemies ascended the great mountain Mahendra, full of grassland inhabited by deer, thickly grown with various trees and creepers full of fragrant flowers and fruits, where roam lions and tigers and proud elephants, a place that echoes with sounds of intoxicated birds and waterfalls.

verses.sloka: बाहुभ्याम् पीडितः तेन महाशैलो महात्मना ।ररास सिंह अभिहतो महान् मत्त इव द्विपः ॥४-६७-४३॥
verses.transliteration: bāhubhyām pīḍitaḥ tena mahāśailo mahātmanā ।rarāsa siṁha abhihato mahān matta iva dvipaḥ ॥4-67-43॥

translations.english: The mighty, preeminent monkey who was equal to Indra in valour took a leap from the high peaks of the tall mountain, Mahendra৷৷

verses.sloka: मुमोच सलिल उत्पीडान् विप्रकीर्ण शिलोउच्चयः ।वित्रस्त मृग मातंगः प्रकंपित महा द्रुमः ॥४-६७-४४॥
verses.transliteration: mumoca salila utpīḍān viprakīrṇa śilouccayaḥ ।vitrasta mṛga mātaṁgaḥ prakaṁpita mahā drumaḥ ॥4-67-44॥

translations.english: Crushed by the feet of the great self, Hanuman, the huge mountain looked like a proud elephant struck by a lion.

verses.sloka: नानागंधर्वमिथुनैर्पानसंसर्गकर्कशैः ।उत्पतद्भिर्विहंगैश्चविद्याधरगणैरपि - यद्वा -नाना गन्धर्व मिथुनैः पान संसर्ग कर्कशैः ।उत् पतद्भिः विहंगैः च विद्याधर गणैः अपि ॥४-६७-४५॥
verses.transliteration: nānāgaṁdharvamithunairpānasaṁsargakarkaśaiḥ ।utpatadbhirvihaṁgaiścavidyādharagaṇairapi - yadvā -nānā gandharva mithunaiḥ pāna saṁsarga karkaśaiḥ ।ut patadbhiḥ vihaṁgaiḥ ca vidyādhara gaṇaiḥ api ॥4-67-45॥

translations.english: The rocks of the mountain got scattered by the force. The deer and elephants were terrified. The trees were shaken up violently and streams of water gushed forth.

verses.sloka: त्यज्यमान महा सानुः संनिलीन महा उरगः ।शैल शृन्ग शिला उत्पातः तदा अभूत् स महा गिरिः ॥४-६७-४६॥
verses.transliteration: tyajyamāna mahā sānuḥ saṁnilīna mahā uragaḥ ।śaila śṛnga śilā utpātaḥ tadā abhūt sa mahā giriḥ ॥4-67-46॥

translations.english: Shaken by the rude shock, couples of intoxicated gandharvas left in a huff the vast slopes of the great mountain. Flocks of birds and groups of vidyadharas flew away. The serpents went into hiding. Rocks fell off the shaken mountain.

verses.sloka: निःश्वसद्भिस्तदातैतुभुजगैरर्धनिःसृतैः ।सपताकैवाभातिसतदाधरणीधरः।यद्वा -निःश्वसद्भिः तदा तैः तु भुजगैः अर्ध निःसृतैः ।स पताक इव आभाति स तदा धरणी धरः ॥४-६७-४७॥
verses.transliteration: niḥśvasadbhistadātaitubhujagairardhaniḥsṛtaiḥ ।sapatākaivābhātisatadādharaṇīdharaḥ।yadvā -niḥśvasadbhiḥ tadā taiḥ tu bhujagaiḥ ardha niḥsṛtaiḥ ।sa patāka iva ābhāti sa tadā dharaṇī dharaḥ ॥4-67-47॥

translations.english: Shaken by the rude shock, couples of intoxicated gandharvas left in a huff the vast slopes of the great mountain. Flocks of birds and groups of vidyadharas flew away. The serpents went into hiding. Rocks fell off the shaken mountain.

verses.sloka: ऋषिभित्राससंभ्रान्तैस्त्यज्यमानश्शिलोच्चयः - यद्वा -ऋषिभिः त्रास संभ्रांतैः त्यज्यमानः शिला उच्चयः ।सीदन् महति कांतारे सार्थ हीन इव अध्व गः ॥४-६७-४८॥
verses.transliteration: ṛṣibhitrāsasaṁbhrāntaistyajyamānaśśiloccayaḥ - yadvā -ṛṣibhiḥ trāsa saṁbhrāṁtaiḥ tyajyamānaḥ śilā uccayaḥ ।sīdan mahati kāṁtāre sārtha hīna iva adhva gaḥ ॥4-67-48॥

translations.english: The serpents with their bodies half protruded out of the rocks and hissing looked like flags planted on the mountain.

verses.sloka: स वेगवान् वेग समाहित आत्माहरि प्रवीरः पर वीर हन्ता ।मनः समाधाय महाअनुभावोजगाम लंकाम् मनसा मनस्वी ॥४-६७-४९॥
verses.transliteration: sa vegavān vega samāhita ātmāhari pravīraḥ para vīra hantā ।manaḥ samādhāya mahāanubhāvojagāma laṁkām manasā manasvī ॥4-67-49॥

translations.english: The alarmed and agitated sages abandonned the mountain peaks.The mountain appeared like a lone traveller separated from the caravan in the great forest.
